name: Fire Hydrant
steps: Start on all fours on the floor with your hands directly beneath your shoulders, knees under your hips, and spine neutral.
Brace your core and keep your working knee bent at 90 degrees as you lift that leg straight out to the side.
Raise your thigh as high as you can without tilting your pelvis or leaning sharply toward the supporting side.
Lower your knee smoothly back toward the floor without resting all your weight on it, and switch sides after completing one leg.
tips: Keep your arms straight and weight evenly distributed between both hands so your torso does not twist.
Move with control and squeeze the side of your glute at the top rather than swinging your leg.
